intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The Night Market. The Syncopator has always been a prankster. Getting ticked only made it worse: now he can ONLY play off the beat.

intro.speaker: The Syncopator
intro.text: Heeey, friends! Love the drum, little guy. Mine now!

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: He snatches Beats' cardboard drum and dances off-beat around the stalls.

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: H-hey! I can't keep time without it! I can't even find where beat one is!

intro.speaker: The Syncopator
intro.text: Want it back? Copy me! Hit the off-beats, and DON'T press on the rests. Hee hee!

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Hang on, Beats. I'll count for both of us this time.

win.speaker: The Syncopator
win.text: Whoa... my head feels like it's back on the beat. Did I take somebody's drum?

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: You did. Give it back, please.

win.speaker: The Syncopator
win.text: Sorry, little guy. Here. Pranks are only funny when you can stop doing them.

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: Clap, you came back for me. Thank you.

win.speaker: Clap
win.text: Always. Last stop before the tower: the Twins' clock shop.

lose.speaker: The Syncopator
lose.text: You pressed on a rest! Classic! Wanna go again?

streak: Who told you where the off-beat was?!
